text:
Rae: quick morning delight: Henrietta the hedgehog sampled my espresso and promptly judged it. photo incoming. :coffee: :hedgehog:
Tom: if a hedgehog judges my brew i will both be honored and deeply embarrassed. :sweat_smile:
Rae: uploaded an image: https://i.imgur.com/HenriettaEspresso.jpg — note the tiny unimpressed nose wrinkle. verdict: needs more crema. :grimacing: :coffee:
Devika: omg that little face. i love that she has Opinions. does she accept critiques? :raised_hands:
Rae: she accepts pats and very slow foam art. she does not accept insults to biscotti. :cookie:
Micah: poll time: Should Henrietta be our resident coffee sommelier emoji? options: (1) yes, judge all brews (2) yes but only for latte art (3) no, she will demand a stipend in worms
ops-bot: Poll created: "Henrietta as coffee emoji?" Options: Judge all brews / Latte-only / Worm stipend. 8 votes cast so far.
Jun: also, note: Henrietta's tiny paw reached for the spoon and that's the hill i will die on. so much dignity. :sparkles:
Tom: i officially nominate a weekly "Henrietta Review" thread where people post photos of their morning drink for judgement. low stakes, high cuteness. :laughing:
Devika: seconded. i will bring croissant prototypes for scientific tasting. :croissant:
Rae: Henrietta demands a scone tasting too. schedule: Friday, 10:30am, bring soft linens. :calendar:
Micah: reaction: :heart: this has made my day. thank you for sharing tiny grumpy energy.
Rae: Henrietta sends a sleepy sniff and a tiny grumpy wiggle. <3
